title.target: C2 review: a polished long-form essay

title.en: C2 review: a polished long-form essay

ex.t: An essay needs a clear thesis.
Check the coherence of the text.
The transitions between paragraphs are smooth.
Supporting arguments rest on concrete evidence.

title.ko: C2 종합: thesis · coherence · register · nuance · rhetoric · conclusion
title.en: C2 review: thesis, coherence, register, nuance, rhetoric, conclusion

explain.ko: 완성도 높은 에세이는 분명한 논지(thesis)에서 출발합니다. 각 문단은 하나의 논거(supporting argument)를 다루고, 매끄러운 전환(transition)으로 연결되어 일관성(coherence)을 갖춥니다. 반론(counter-argument)을 인정한 뒤 반박하면 설득력이 높아지며, 독자와 목적에 맞는 문체(register)를 일관되게 유지해야 합니다. 결론은 새로운 주장을 더하지 않고 논지를 다시 확인합니다. 정확한 어휘와 미묘한 뉘앙스, 적절한 수사가 글을 세련되게 합니다.
explain.en: A polished essay starts from a clear thesis. Each paragraph deals with one supporting argument and is linked by smooth transitions, achieving coherence. Acknowledging and then rebutting counter-arguments increases persuasiveness, and the register must be kept consistent and suited to reader and purpose. The conclusion reaffirms the thesis without adding new claims. Precise vocabulary, subtle nuance and judicious rhetoric polish the text.

lines.t: A polished essay has a clear thesis, concrete supporting arguments, handling of counter-arguments, a consistent register, smooth transitions and a conclusion that reaffirms the thesis. With precise vocabulary, subtle nuance and judicious rhetoric added, the text becomes polished.

items.passage:
WRITING GUIDE
The polished essay
A polished essay starts from a clear thesis. Each paragraph deals with one supporting argument and is linked by smooth transitions. In the conclusion, do not add new claims; reaffirm the thesis.

prompt.ko: 논지, 논거, 반론, 결론을 갖춘 짧은 에세이를 4문장으로 써 보세요.
prompt.en: Write a short essay in four sentences with a thesis, a supporting argument, a counter-argument and a conclusion.

task.model: The thesis of this essay is that reading cultivates critical thinking. One supporting argument is exposure to diverse perspectives. As a counter-argument, some point to a lack of time. However, this does not undermine the value of reading, and the thesis remains valid.

model_trans.ko: 이 에세이의 논지는 독서가 비판적 사고를 기른다는 것입니다. 한 가지 논거는 다양한 관점에 노출된다는 점입니다. 반론으로는 시간이 부족하다는 지적이 있습니다. 그러나 이는 독서의 가치를 훼손하지 않으며, 논지는 여전히 유효합니다.
model_trans.en: The thesis of this essay is that reading cultivates critical thinking. One supporting argument is exposure to diverse perspectives. As a counter-argument, some point to a lack of time. However, this does not undermine the value of reading, and the thesis remains valid.
